notes: Use one canonical snapshot row per player-market validation row, usually the latest available pre-lock snapshot.
current_line should match the playable line for over_odds/under_odds. If absent in source, set current_line = line.
close_* fields must be closing prices and must not be used as model features.
Valid American odds are <= -100 or >= +100. Rows outside that range must be repaired with source-specific logic or dropped before no-vig conversion.
